programs.description: Little Indrajeet migrates to New York as per his father's wish of educating him abroad. However, he is unable to adapt to the new lifestyle and tries to run away.
After he witnesses his entire family getting murdered over a video call, Surya decides to avenge their deaths. His fiancée, Gayathri, who is mourning the death of her brother, is ready to help him.
Bringing the best in cinema.
Pradeep marries Roshni without his family's consent. However, Roshni decides to move to her friend Shailaja's house with Pradeep, unaware that she is Pradeep's sister-in-law.
Mohan and Yamuna fall in love with each other and get married. However, their marriage hits troubled waters after Mohan confesses that he unexpectedly cheated on her with one of her friends.

Amid the Swadeshi movement unrest, Mahimchandra, a detective in the Bengal police, is on a quest for the perfect crime to enliven his mundane job, which jeopardises his personal and professional life.
A family has to deal with the fact that the father, who is also the one that holds the family together, has developed Alzheimer's disease.
A modern-day Robin Hood thrives on stealing from the rich. However, he reluctantly becomes a bodyguard for a high-profile client due to unforeseen circumstances.
Stephen, a quadriplegic, befriends John, a musician, and they develop a good rapport. However, their friendship is put to the test when Anjali enters their lives.
Kannan and Radha share a deep romantic bond that transcends eras and emotions. However, they must navigate various obstacles together as their timeless affection continues to grow.
Rajalakshmi, who leads a lonely life, adopts Solomon after he loses his parents in a car accident. Solomon tries to help Rajalakshmi solve several problems that come her way.
